snippet.title: Bus Simulator : World Tour - Playstation 5 Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP2649-PPSA33620_00-0028536997502628

Bus Simulator: World Tour delivers the ultimate bus‑driving experience with realistic mechanics, detailed environments, and a massive fleet of vehicles. Travel the world behind the wheel of 30 unique buses across 14 real‑life inspired locations and complete 140 routes packed with variety and challenge. Customize your ride, explore freely, and enjoy a true next‑generation Bus Simulator built for immersion.

Features:

• Drive 30 buses across multiple categories: Diesel, Hybrid, Electric, Articulated, Coach, Double‑Decker, and School Bus
• 140 unique routes spread across 14 global environments, including San Francisco, Interstate, Texas, Boston, Buenos Aires, Madrid, London, Saxony, Berlin, Prague, St. Petersburg, Dubai, Shanghai, and Tohoku
• ~50 hours of driving gameplay, featuring routes that range from quick 3‑minute drives to immersive 30‑minute journeys, all with infinite replayability
• Enjoy a Free Ride mode for relaxed exploration
• Supports steering wheels and pedals; compatibility may vary by model
• Deep customization: exterior, interior, decals, performance upgrades, decorations, horns, rims, seats, and more

Take the driver’s seat, start your engine, and experience the world like never before. Your journey begins now.
